title: gentiana acuta var. plebeia
intro: Gentiana acuta var. plebeia, commonly known as the Korean gentian or Chinese gentian, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. It is traditionally used in East Asian medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gentiana acuta var. plebeia are attributed to its ability to modulate immune function, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant and hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, gentiopicrin, and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
